title: ==TESTING ENGINEER QAE==  ·  FUNCTIONAL & REGRESSION TESTING

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Quality assurance engineer with **4.8 years of experience** performing **functional and regression testing** and **validating system performance**. Executed end-to-end test cycles across payment, gaming, retail, and education applications, with automation and performance testing (JMeter) to validate system behaviour at scale.

rows: Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)

roles.title: Software Test Engineer / Senior QA
bullets: ==Performed functional and regression testing== for web/mobile modules; authored 500+ test cases.
==Validated system performance== — executed performance tests with JMeter for critical flows; identified bottlenecks that improved response times by 15%.
Cut release verification time from 3 days → 1 day via CI/CD-integrated automated suites.

bullets: ==Performed functional and regression testing== for payment, gaming, and retail applications.
